name: Download Monitor
couldBuild: Files behind a post type, download counting, versioned files and a shortcode. Genuinely straightforward, and the free plugin already does it.
stillMissing: The paid half is gating and abuse: email-gated downloads wired to your mailing list, bot and hotlink defence that does not also block real users, and per-user access rules. Useful, but a smaller gap than most of this index.
requirements: Download post type with versioning and access logging
Gated downloads collecting an email into your mailing list
Bot, hotlink and abuse protection on the download endpoint

alternatives.name: Download Monitor (free)
alternatives.desc: Files, versioning and counting free; gating and analytics are the paid extensions.

alternatives.name: WordPress media library
alternatives.desc: For ungated files a plain media link and a counter plugin often suffice.
